_readme: One place for everything campus-specific. The Node scripts and the app both read this, so pointing the project at another campus means editing this file and re-running `npm run fetch -- --force && npm run build:data`. Note that the map's centre, zoom and pan limits are NOT here: they are derived from the campus boundary at build time and land in campus.json.
name: IIEST Shibpur
longName: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur

places._note: fromOsm=false ships a map with no places on it at all — just the ground, the buildings and the paths — so every place can be put on by hand via tag mode or data/curated/places.json. Set it to true to have the build classify OSM features into places again; nothing else needs to change.
